people.name: Nate Soares
people.snippet: Nathaniel Soares is an American artificial intelligence author and researcher known for his work on existential risk from AI. [1][2] In 2014, Soares co-authored a paper that introduced the term AI alignment, the challenge of making increasingly capable AIs behave as intended.
